revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing a warehouse passage. Scene includes pallets, industrial shelving, clear floor markings, painted loading-bay concrete, and partial shadow from a nearby structure while keeping clear subject detail. Right-oblique view, slightly distant framing, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Visible subject is a tall broad-built adult worker wearing a reflective safety vest over neutral brown and cream clothing, performing a controlled plank beside a marked work area, with hands and feet actively supporting the body and no passive ground rest. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, with a column or partition partly framing one side of the image. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or annotation.
